title: Deep learning predicts breast cancer TIL levels from ultrasound images
summary: In 494 retrospectively enrolled breast cancer patients from two hospitals (298 training, 98 internal validation, 98 external validation), five deep learning models predicted pathologically confirmed TIL levels from ultrasound images. The best model, an attention-based DenseNet121, reached an AUC of 0.873, accuracy 79.5%, sensitivity 90.7% and specificity 65.9% in the external cohort. Performance was reported as good in each molecular subgroup. Retrospective two-hospital study.
ai_technology: Five deep learning models including attention-based DenseNet121 and transformer or CNN architectures on breast ultrasound images
